m_tallyCounter.m_descriptor: The Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly Shrine

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>That is the Crystal Skull that was stolen from the Oracle. Apparently Morganthe's forces used it to open the shrine. </ITALICS>

m_tallyCounter.m_descriptor: the Entrance to the Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly Shrine

m_goals.m_locationName: Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly Shrine

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You take it off the pedestal, as it is likely still too potent to just be left lying around. </ITALICS>
Ahhh, young Wizard! Welcome to the Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly. You never fail to surprise me with your ability to survive.
My obligation to the Shadow Queen is complete. With Huracan in her hands, nothing can stop Morganthe from reaching Xibalba!
She will perform her greatest act of Necromancy upon the comet, causing it to fall out of the sky and kill everyone!
Thus, it is time for me to leave, once I help myself to these relics. You are welcome to leave me in peace, or...

m_goals.m_locationName: Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly Shrine

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>Sacre bleu!</ITALICS> Next time, dear Wizard, it will take more than a few spells to save you!

m_goals.m_locationName: Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly Shrine

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>There is a beautiful jeweled Conch Shell upon this pedestal. You reach out for it when it jumps! </ITALICS>
Hey! Hands off! This is my home!
<ITALICS>The Conch Shell scurries off and vanishes! </ITALICS>
Huracan is missing? That cannot be good!
Huracan? That is the name of the Thunder Horn priest who tends the shrine called Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly.
Perhaps Huracan Vicious Sky knows of this "Horn that Calls" that the Shadow Queen is searching for.
The Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly is nestled off the Black Tooth Gorge. Go there and look for the priest!
Find the Wings of the Obsidian Butterfly Shrine off the Black Tooth Gorge and search for the priest Huracan Vicious Sky!
